provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: patch average at L89 divides by cell_m twice (/cell_m/cell_m) rather than cell_m*cell_n; numerically identical only because cell_m==cell_n==4 (L22-23)
column index 2+(jj-1)*cell_n+ii (L72) uses cell_n as the stride over ii which ranges 1..cell_m (L68-69); correct flattening only while cell_m==cell_n
audit_member_text: Two flattening/averaging formulas incorrectly assume square subcells. L72 advances each jj row by `cell_n` but indexes ii across `cell_m`; the row stride must be cell_m. L89 divides the cell sum by cell_m twice instead of cell_m*cell_n. Active cell_m=cell_n=4 masks both defects, but rectangular configurations corrupt metadata columns and coarse averages.

base_member_text: dep_bottom=9999.0 (L26) is defined but never referenced anywhere in the file
audit_member_text: dep_bottom=9999 is defined at L26 but never used. dep_top is added as an offset to local coarse depth at L64 rather than assigned as an absolute top elevation/depth; the intended meaning is unstated.

base_member_text: obstacle sub-window formulas (L37-40) place the 3x3 window at rows/cols 1:3 of the 4x4 cell, i.e. offset toward the low-index corner, not symmetric — whether intended is not stated
block region starts at coarse column m_start=400 with nx_blocks=100 (L32, L34) reaching column 499, one short of nx_total=500 (L3); coverage intent not documented in this file

dep_cell_add and dep_sub_writeout are indexed without preallocation (L64, L70-72); dep_cell_add(:,:) on the left side requires the variable to already exist on first iteration in some MATLAB versions — no initialization appears in this file

audit_member_text: Block bounds are not validated against the coarse/fine grids or obs_m/obs_n against cell_m/cell_n. Parameter edits can drive j_coarse/i_coarse or n1:n2/m1:m2 out of range.

dep_level clips negative depths to zero only for dep_sub averaging (L79-L89), while dep_full and dep_sub_info retain negatives. Thus coarse and fine outputs are not direct conservative representations of one another around exposed blocks.
Hard-coded dimension-bearing filenames become stale if grid parameters change; plot directory and fopen success are unchecked.
